actions.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

dimensions.assessment: Affects manufacturers and developers of a specific class of drugs (engineered cyclic peptides) and federal health programs.
dimensions.evidence: in the case of an engineered cyclic peptide... 11 years

dimensions.assessment: Extends the non-interaction period before price negotiation from 7 years to 11 years for qualifying drugs.
dimensions.evidence: in the case of an engineered cyclic peptide (as defined in paragraph (5)), 11 years

dimensions.assessment: Modifies timelines for federal drug price negotiations, potentially affecting federal spending on pharmaceutical drugs over time.
dimensions.evidence: qualifying single source drugs for purposes of the Drug Price Negotiation Program

dimensions.assessment: Makes a targeted amendment to a specific section of Title XI of the Social Security Act.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1192(e) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1320f-1(e)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent statutory rule for drug price negotiation listings published on or after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: apply with respect to lists published under section 1192(a) of the Social Security Act on or after the date of enactment

missing_information: Exact number of drugs that qualify as engineered cyclic peptides under the new definition.
importance_detail.rationale: Amends the Social Security Act to adjust the negotiation timeline under the Drug Price Negotiation Program specifically for engineered cyclic peptides.
